summary: Gone: a pole L-4 tower the register dates to 1937. Its 1934-dated photo caption names the station; the sources do not explain the gap.

facts.status_note: Tower is gone. The sources give no removal date.

events.note: Pole L-4 tower built, per the register and firelookout.com
Panorama photo dated 4-18-34 and captioned as a Saddle Guard Station lookout; conflicts with the 1937 build year
Registered November 15, 2010; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: Pole L-4 tower built in 1937, now gone
evidence.quote: A pole L-4 tower was built in 1937 and is now gone.

notes_for_editor: The 1937 build date is a new built event: the record had only the 2010 registration, so this is an addition, not a correction. Both listings give 1937 for a pole L-4 tower. The register's photo caption dates a Saddle Guard Station Lookout panorama to 4-18-34, three years earlier. The sources do not explain this. The photo URL in the record names 'saddle-mtn', so the picture may show Saddle Mountain rather than the station; an editor should check the original photo record at the National Archives. The 1934 event is kept as type other because the caption is the only evidence for it. Two web searches found no Saddle Guard lookout or station in Siuslaw or Lane County histories. Access and staffing are unknown and left out. No site-today source was found.
